note: SEMIFINAL / FINAL CUP DRAW CAPTURE (2026-08-02, s91). Five career drives failed to bank a SEMIFINAL or FINAL draw because FUN_004d9a00 refuses to paint a draw the managed club is not in (s89's read gate, club+0x5c != 0xffff) -- and two Man Utd runs (s90) were RELEGATED in season 1 without reaching one. This run stops gambling on the roll: it boots MANAGER_CAP.EXE, built by `build_hack_exe.py --cheats=cupdraw_always,unsackable`, which flips that ONE gate byte (0x4d9b26 jne -> jmp) plus the three board-dismissal branches. The gate sets no state and the tie/club array the screen then renders is the sim's own, so every frame banked is MANAGER.EXE painting a REAL draw with REAL clubs -- verified live on the very first screen of this run, a Coca-Cola Cup ROUND 1 draw of Luton T./Wycombe W./Bristol City/Colchester U./Chester C./Oldham Ath, a round Manchester Utd. is not in and the stock EXE would have painted nothing for. `unsackable` is here so a relegation cannot end the drive before the later rounds. The port keeps the real gate; this is a capture instrument only.
